description: Price a set of placements exactly as the store's checkout would, including the 3.5% processing fee. Use this to give a client a total before creating an order. Quoting does not reserve anything. Placements that are not available are refused. An item with a niche is priced at the outlet's price for that niche; where that differs from the standard price there is no shareUrl, since the store's cart charges standard prices.

niche.description: The restricted subject the article is on, if any: CBD, Crypto, Health, Gambling or Erotic. Priced at the outlet's price for that niche, and refused where the outlet doesn't accept it.

quantity.description: How many of this placement; at least 1. Defaults to 1.
